name: Service Discovery
description: Use when the user asks to discover, map, inventory, memorize, or refresh their services and infrastructure — Railway projects/services/domains, Vercel projects, Notion data sources, Slack channels — or when you are about to work with one of those services and your memory holds no inventory for it. Teaches: check memory first, enumerate via the service proxy, persist compact durable facts to memory, refresh by forget-then-retain, and optionally seed another agent's memory.
human_description: Discovers connected services once and commits them to agent memory.
